summary: Iteration 104: Complete testing of Instagram Ranking Run Inside (Social Blade) feature. All backend APIs (10/10 tests) and frontend features verified successfully. The feature allows manual analysis of Instagram profiles with 15+ input fields, calculates 7 metrics with scores, and displays results using 7 different chart types.

issues: Hydration warning: '<tr> cannot be child of <span>' - Known React hydration issue in RankingTable, doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Backend (instagram_routes.py): All 7 formula calculations implemented correctly - Taxa Curtidas, Views Reels, Engajamento, Curtidas, Comentários, Crescimento, Posts
Backend: graficos_data returns all 7 sections with proper data structure for charts
Frontend (DashboardInstagram.jsx): Form modal with 4 sections and 15+ fields working correctly
Frontend: All 7 chart types rendered using Recharts - Donut, Barras, Pizza, Colunas, Linhas, Radar, Histograma
Frontend: Scores por Métrica section displays individual scores and overall average
Frontend: Export XLSX and CSV buttons functional with token-based auth
seed_data_creation: Created test analyses during testing: test_formulas_*, test_with_foto_*, test_export_*, test_csv_*, test_grades_*, test_playwright_ui
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 104 validated the complete Instagram Ranking Run Inside (Social Blade) feature. Backend endpoints tested: POST /api/admin/instagram/analisar-simplificado (create analysis with 15+ fields), POST /api/admin/instagram/upload-foto (photo upload), GET /api/admin/instagram/analises (list), GET /api/admin/instagram/analises/{id} (view with graficos_data), DELETE /api/admin/instagram/analises/{id}, GET /api/admin/instagram/export/{id} (XLSX), GET /api/admin/instagram/export-csv/{id} (CSV). Frontend verified: Form modal with 4 sections (Identificação, Dados Gerais, Crescimento 30d, Interações 30d), Result page with 7 charts (Donut, Barras, Pizza, Colunas, Linhas, Radar, Histograma), Scores por Métrica section, Export buttons.

Backend API - POST analisar-simplificado.details: Creates analysis with all 15+ manual fields, calculates 7 formulas, returns graficos_data with all 7 sections

Backend API - POST upload-foto.details: Uploads profile photo, returns foto_url path

Backend API - GET analises.details: Lists all analyses with proper data

Backend API - GET analises/{id}.details: Returns analysis with complete graficos_data including all 7 chart sections and scores

Backend API - DELETE analises/{id}.details: Deletes analysis, returns 404 on subsequent GET

Backend API - Export XLSX.details: Returns valid XLSX file with correct content-type

Backend API - Export CSV.details: Returns valid CSV file with correct content-type

Frontend - Form Modal.details: 4 sections with 15+ fields: Identificação (username, nome, data, foto upload), Dados Gerais (seguidores, seguindo, posts, nota, classificações), Crescimento 30d (ganho, perda, médias semanais), Interações 30d (posts, views reels, curtidas, comentários)

Frontend - 7 Charts.details: All 7 chart types displayed: 1. Donut (Nota), 2. Barras (Views Reels), 3. Pizza (Engajamento), 4. Colunas (Curtidas), 5. Linhas (Comentários), 6. Radar (Crescimento), 7. Histograma (Posts)

Frontend - Scores Section.details: Displays individual scores for 6 metrics and overall Score Médio Geral

Frontend - Export Buttons.details: Exportar XLSX and Exportar CSV buttons present and functional

Frontend - List View.details: Shows analyses with badge, username, name, followers, engagement, score, date, view/delete buttons
